name: idle-micro-compact
description: Compacts an idle session before its prompt cache expires: first by masking old tool results and dropping thinking with no model call, falling back to a summary when that would not shrink it enough.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Minutes idle before compacting. The default of 50 leaves 10 minutes before a 1-hour prompt cache expires.

minTokens.title: Minimum conversation tokens
minTokens.description: Leave smaller conversations alone: re-reading them cold is cheap. The system prompt and tools don't count.

microTargetTokens.title: Micro-compaction target
microTargetTokens.description: Mask old tool results and drop thinking, with no model call, when that is estimated to leave the conversation at or under this many tokens. Above it, write a summary instead.

minSavedShare.title: Minimum trim saving
minSavedShare.description: Leave the conversation alone when a trim is estimated to save less than this share of it, from 0 to 1: 0.1 is 10%. A trim rewrites the transcript, so the next request writes all of it to the cache again.
